column5: FIGMA PARITY NEAR-COMPLETE: 15 of 22 frames carry a `match` visual verdict (Pre Game 9069-959, Full Game 9069-859 plus its Adjusted Slider / Roll Over / Win Chance / Multiplier states, Auto 9062-17693, Auto No Infinity 9069-1068, Auto Advanced Displayed 9065-1579 and Extended 9062-16886, tablet 9003-44223, mobile 9003-44847), and the page is routed at /play/dice via DicePage + DicePageSections. THREE NAMED RESIDUALS, all frame-specific. (1) 9003-44542 Tablet Alt is NOT BUILT - it is the rival of 9003-44223 and was deferred, so one of the two titled 768 screens has no implementation. (2) 9069-1141 Desktop First Roll is built as static chrome only; the post-roll pill fill - the single state that frame exists to specify - has never been exercised because the local POINTS balance is 0, so a roll returns an honest insufficient-balance reject. (3) The practice-mode toggle drawn in 9003-43516 is a PERMANENT deliberate divergence (no game gets Practice/Fun/Demo; POINTS is the free-play path), not a gap. The 7 unverified ids are Figma artifact layers (CTA/button, card, a misfiled Home frame 2736-25840) with no UI to build. Remaining 13 never-seen ids confirmed to be artifact layers - no unbuilt surface is hiding in this file. ★ ONE SUBSTANTIVE RENDERING DEFECT: the multiplier readout that frame 9069-2378 exists to specify prints a max 9500x from diceOdds.ts:21,35 (95/chance, 5% edge) while the LIVE POINTS rail points-game/index.ts:5354-5356 pays 99/chance - at threshold 1 the panel shows 9500x and the rail pays 9900x, i.e. every winning bet pays 4.21% more than the frame quotes, uncapped, at a 1000-point stake cap. diceOdds.test.ts:35-38 asserts the client value and labels the rail's actual behaviour 'the old 1%-edge bug' - green over a live divergence. The dormant money rail game-settlement:1423 agrees with the client, so enabling it would silently drop every payout 4.21%. No _shared/dice.ts exists.
